title: The Green Room
description: A nervous college student struggles to deliver a presentation on stage, finds her footing, and wins over the lecture hall.
character_reference: a young woman with shoulder-length dark curly hair, wearing an oversized beige cardigan and round glasses

scenes.narration: My palms were ice cold as the professor called my name to the podium. The lecture hall stretched out endlessly, a sea of waiting faces.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a young woman sweating under bright overhead lights, hands trembling slightly against a dark wooden podium, blurred auditorium seating in background, cinematic depth of field

scenes.narration: I opened my slides, but my throat locked up completely. The first three words vanished from my mind like smoke.
scenes.visual: extreme close up of nervous eyes staring fixedly at a glowing laptop screen reflecting blue light, fingers frozen over a touchpad, dark moody interior atmosphere

scenes.narration: Instead of bolting for the exit, I took a deliberate, shaky breath and gripped the edge of the desk. I needed to reset.
scenes.visual: close up of knuckles whitening from gripping a wooden lectern edge, shoulders dropping in a slow exhale, warm ambient lighting

scenes.narration: I skipped the rehearsed intro and just started talking about why the topic mattered to me personally. My voice stopped shaking.
scenes.visual: medium shot looking upward at a confident speaker gesturing naturally with one open hand, soft spotlight illuminating the center stage

scenes.narration: Rows of people who had been staring at their phones actually looked up. Someone in the front row nodded in quiet agreement.
scenes.visual: over the shoulder view of a speaker looking down at an engaged audience member nodding attentively in a softly lit lecture hall

scenes.narration: When I delivered my final sentence, the silence broke into genuine applause. I did not just survive the room, I owned it.
scenes.visual: medium profile shot of a smiling student standing tall at a wooden podium, bathed in warm applause lighting, sense of relief and triumph

scenes.narration: If you love real stories about figuring life out one step at a time, follow along for more.
scenes.visual: warm cinematic portrait of a smiling young adult looking directly into the camera lens with genuine confidence, cozy room background
